name: rosetta-jewels-and-stones
code:
use default

count_jewels(stones: string, jewels: string) -> int =>
    stones
        |> filter((stone: char) => jewels.index_of(stone) >= 0)
        |> count()

for pair in [(stones = "aAAbbbb", jewels = "aA"),
             (stones = "ZZ", jewels = "z"),
             (stones = "AbCdEfGh", jewels = "aEiOu")] do
    let found = count_jewels(pair.stones, pair.jewels)

    write_line("{pair.stones} contains {found} of {pair.jewels}")
od
fullSource:
use default

count_jewels(stones: string, jewels: string) -> int =>
    stones
        |> filter((stone: char) => jewels.index_of(stone) >= 0)
        |> count()

for pair in [(stones = "aAAbbbb", jewels = "aA"),
             (stones = "ZZ", jewels = "z"),
             (stones = "AbCdEfGh", jewels = "aEiOu")] do
    let found = count_jewels(pair.stones, pair.jewels)

    write_line("{pair.stones} contains {found} of {pair.jewels}")
od
